summary: Pitch shifter, frequency shifter and ring modulator in one effect. Pitch moves every partial by the same ratio (-24 to +24 semitones and cents) with a two-tap delay-line shifter (Fast, a Window of 10 to 100 ms sets its latency and smoothness) or a phase-locked phase vocoder (Smooth, 2047 samples of latency) and a stereo detune for doubling. Frequency moves every partial by the same number of hertz (-2000 to +2000 Hz, a single sideband) with a feedback for the rising or falling barber-pole and a Spread that shifts the right side the other way. Ring multiplies the sound by a carrier of 1 Hz to 5 kHz (sine, triangle or square, band-limited) with a Depth from amplitude modulation to full ring. Notes in can set the pitch shift (against a Root) or the carrier. Low and High cut on the wet path, Mix and Amount (0 and Mix 0 are bit-exact dry). Use it for octaves, fifths, doubling, metallic bells, throbbing tremolo and endless rising or falling echoes.
use_for: Shift the pitch by semitones (fast or smooth, with stereo detune), shift every frequency by hertz for barber-pole and bell tones, or ring-modulate; notes can set the shift or the carrier.

parameters.name: Mode
parameters.description: What the effect does: pitch shift, frequency shift or ring modulation
parameters.how: Chooses between moving all partials by a ratio, moving all partials by a number of hertz, or multiplying the sound by a carrier.
parameters.sound: Pitch keeps the harmonics in tune, Frequency bends them into bell-like or barber-pole tones, Ring adds the sum and difference of the sound and the carrier.

parameters.name: Pitch
parameters.description: Pitch shift in semitones, -24 to +24
parameters.how: Sets the shift in whole semitones.
parameters.sound: Seven up is a fifth above, twelve up an octave, twelve down an octave below.

parameters.name: Fine
parameters.description: Fine pitch shift in cents, added to the semitones
parameters.how: Adds a fine shift in cents (a hundredth of a semitone) to the semitones.
parameters.sound: A few cents against the dry sound make a slow chorus-like beat.

parameters.name: Quality
parameters.description: Fast: a two-tap delay-line shifter, latency half the Window. Smooth: a phase-locked phase vocoder, 2047 samples of latency
parameters.how: Chooses the delay-line shifter (Fast, short latency, a slight warble on low notes) or the phase vocoder (Smooth, clean on chords and pads, a longer latency).
parameters.sound: Fast is tight and a little rough on low notes, Smooth stays clear on chords and held notes but follows a fast attack a little late.

parameters.name: Window
parameters.description: Fast: the length of the shifter's window, 10 to 100 ms; also its latency (half of it)
parameters.how: Sets the window of the Fast shifter; a longer window is smoother on low notes, a shorter one is tighter.
parameters.sound: Short windows add a fast flutter to low notes, long ones smear attacks and add delay.

parameters.name: Stereo detune
parameters.description: The left side is shifted down and the right side up by this many cents, for doubling
parameters.how: Shifts the left channel down and the right channel up by this many cents.
parameters.sound: A few cents widen the sound into a double; more makes it seasick.

parameters.name: Shift
parameters.description: Frequency shift in hertz, -2000 to +2000: every partial moves by the same number of hertz
parameters.how: Moves every frequency of the sound up (or down) by the same number of hertz.
parameters.sound: A few hertz make a slow phasing, tens of hertz bend a voice into a metallic one, hundreds make bells.

parameters.name: Shift fine
parameters.description: Fine frequency shift in hertz, added to Shift
parameters.how: Adds a fine shift of up to 5 Hz to Shift, in steps of 0.01 Hz.
parameters.sound: Fractions of a hertz give the slowest phasing there is.

parameters.name: Feedback
parameters.description: Share of the shifted sound fed back in: positive rises, negative falls (-95 to +95 %)
parameters.how: Feeds the shifted sound back into the shifter, so each repeat moves again.
parameters.sound: Positive values make a rising barber-pole, negative values a falling one; high values ring on.

parameters.name: Spread
parameters.description: The right side is shifted the other way by this share of the shift
parameters.how: Shifts the right channel by the opposite amount (100 % = the left and right shifts mirror each other).
parameters.sound: Left rises while the right falls: a wide, swirling stereo image.

parameters.name: Carrier
parameters.description: Carrier frequency, 1 Hz to 5 kHz
parameters.how: Sets the frequency of the oscillator the sound is multiplied with.
parameters.sound: Below 20 Hz it is a tremolo, in the audio range it adds sum and difference tones: metal, bells, robots.

parameters.name: Shape
parameters.description: The carrier's shape (triangle and square are band-limited)
parameters.how: Chooses the carrier's waveform.
parameters.sound: Sine gives two clean sidebands, triangle and square add more, brighter ones.

parameters.name: Depth
parameters.description: 0 % = amplitude modulation (the sound keeps its own level), 100 % = ring modulation (only the sidebands)
parameters.how: Blends from amplitude modulation (the original stays) to ring modulation (the original is gone).
parameters.sound: At 0 % the sound is only tremolo-ed, at 100 % it is replaced by sum and difference tones.

parameters.name: Follow notes
parameters.description: Notes set the effect: the pitch shift in Pitch mode (note minus Root), the carrier in Ring mode
parameters.how: Lets the notes sent to this machine set the shift or the carrier.
parameters.sound: Play the machine like an instrument: harmonies from a single voice, or a ring modulator tuned to the keys.

parameters.name: Root
parameters.description: The note that means no shift (MIDI note, 60 = C4)
parameters.how: Sets the note at which Pitch mode does not shift; other notes shift by the distance from it.
parameters.sound: Play a fifth above the root and the sound moves up a fifth.

parameters.name: Low cut
parameters.description: High-pass on the wet path
parameters.how: Removes low frequencies from the shifted sound only.
parameters.sound: Takes the rumble out of a pitch-shifted-down sound.

parameters.name: High cut
parameters.description: Low-pass on the wet path
parameters.how: Removes high frequencies from the shifted sound only.
parameters.sound: Takes the fizz and aliasing out of shifted-up and ring-modulated sounds.

parameters.name: Mix
parameters.description: Dry/wet (the dry signal is delayed by the latency)
parameters.how: Blends the processed sound with the dry input.
parameters.sound: Lower values keep the original and lay the effect on top.

parameters.name: Amount
parameters.description: Effect strength: 100 % = the settings as they stand, 0 = clean (bit for bit the input), 200 % = twice the shift, fine shift, detune, feedback and spread
parameters.how: Scales the pitch, the fine shift, the detune, the frequency shift, the feedback, the spread and the ring depth together.
parameters.sound: Turn it down to fade the effect out, up to push the shift twice as far; at 0 the sound is clean.

parameters.name: Output
parameters.description: Output level of the wet sound
parameters.how: Sets the level of the processed sound.
parameters.sound: Pitch shifts and ring modulation change the loudness; trim it here.
